d:
Jamui is a scenic and historically place in southeastern Bihar, known for its hills, forests and deep roots in Jain heritage.
From hilltop temples and forest landscapes to sacred sites, ancient traditions and historic landmarks, Jamui offers many different experiences in one journey.
The region is also closely associated with the Jain tradition and the life of Lord Mahavira, adding another important layer to its history.
A journey through Jamui is a chance to experience Bihar through faith, nature, history and local culture..
